name: Dual Soul
source:
Gush is a treasure hunter. He is searching for the Gomalie ruins at the request of Evonos Church with three friends. As he was leaving the ruins he got caught in the trap and got multiple spear piercing wounds. He should have died but he awoke at the bed. His appearance changed drastically as he took the form of Edner who fell from the roof at the same time. He is sentenced to live as Edner by the church bishop. Then suspicious events start to happen one by one...

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-april-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
Gush是一名寻宝猎人。他受Evonos教会委托，与三名朋友一同寻找Gomalie遗迹。离开遗迹时，他触发陷阱，被多支长矛贯穿身体。本该死去的他却在床上醒来，外貌也发生了巨大变化，变成了同一时刻从屋顶坠落的Edner。教会主教判定他今后必须以Edner的身份生活。随后，可疑事件接二连三地发生…
